3. In the year 2004, the Petitioner sat for the examination of the Public Service Commission under the President's quota of 10 (ten) percent and stood 1st. He was accordingly promoted to the post of Assistant Professor and was posted at Government Haraganga College, Munshiganj on 6-1-2005 (Annexure-D). To the utter surprise of the Petitioner he was subsequently transferred to Satkania Government College, Satkania, Chittagong vide order dated 7-3-2007 issued by the Directorate of Secondary and Higher Education, Dhaka, Bangladesh, stating, inter alia,  “তাদের আবেদনের পরিপ্রেক্ষিতে---” (Annexure-E). At the time of the said transfer, the Petitioner was suffering from jaundice and was in his village town, Manikganj. His health condition having deteriorated, he had to undergo intense treatment resulting in his failure to join Satkania College within time (Annexure-G series). The Petitioner accordingly made a representation to the Director General of Secondary and Higher Education, Dhaka, Bangladesh to withdraw the transfer order on the ground that he never applied for the same, but his request was not entertained. Being aggrieved and frustrated by the unilateral transfer order, the Petitioner vide letter dated 18-4-2007 tendered his resignation (Annexure-H). It has been emphatically contended that at the time of tendering the Petitioner was seriously ill and was diagnosed with "General Anxiety Disorder" from 10-3-2007 till 9-9-2007 (Annexure-G series). Since the Petitioner was facing severe financial crisis and was finding it difficult to cope with the various expenses of his treatment, consequent there to he had to sell his personal household goods belonging to him. Ultimately, the Petitioner regained his health around 9-9-2007 and after having recovered from illness, vide letter dated 10-9-2007 he made an application to the Secretary, Ministry of Education for granting him extraordinary leave for the said period without pay and for posting him to any Degree College situated within Dhaka (Annexure-I). The similar nature of prayer was allowed in the case of one Mr Ahmadul Bari, a Lecturer of Bengali Department, in Dhaka College who remained absent from 5-6-1998 till 26-8-2003 without leave, was granted 'extraordinary leave" with retrospective effect vide letter dated 27-2-2005 (Annexure-J series). The petitioner following the verbal advice of the then Director-General made an application on 13-9-2007 for joining as an Assistant Professor in the Department of Philosophy at Satkania College, but he was not allowed to join in the respective post on the count that the allotted time for joining at Satkania College had elapsed. Subsequently, the application dated 10-9-2007 of the Petitioner and the opinion expressed by the Principal of Satkania College was sent by the Petitioner to the Ministry of Education (Annexure-K) for consideration. Vide letter dated 15-1-2008 the Ministry of Education requested the Ministry of Establishment to give opinion on the issue of the Petitioner (Annexure-L). Vide letter dated 28-2-2008, the Ministry of Establishment stated, inter alia, that the appointing authority in its discretion could take any decision in this regard i.e., it could either accept the resignation or accept the withdrawal of resignation so submitted by the Petitioner (Annexure-M). Vide letter dated 30-4-2008 and 9-5-2008 respectively, the Ministry of Education and the Directorate of the Secondary and Higher Education, Dhaka, Bangladesh sought for production of necessary documents in order to take decision on the issue of the Petitioner (Annexure-N series). Vide letter dated 13-5-2008, the Petitioner wrote to the Secretary, Ministry of Education expressing his intention to withdraw his resignation (Annexure-O). Vide letter dated 22-6-2008, he also made representation to the Hon'ble President of the Country narrating the situation and made a prayer to allow him to continue his service (Annexure-E). The prayer of the Petitioner to withdraw his earlier application of resignation was turned down vide impugned memo dated 22-7-2008 issued by the Ministry of Education intimating the Petitioner that his resignation had been duly accepted (Annexure-Q). However, vide the government notification dated 10-2-2009 the Ministry of Establishment by giving general information invited the concerned government servants to place their grievances to the Review Committee so constituted for the said purpose. The Petitioner accordingly made representation vide letter dated 9-2-2009 to the Hon'ble Prime Minister of the country as well as the Chairman of the Review Committee with a prayer to withdraw the order of acceptance of his resignation (Annexure-R) but there was no result till date. Hence, the Petitioner was constrained to file the present application and ultimately obtained the present Rule. 

 11. From the chronology of facts as narrated in the Writ Petition it appears that allegedly on his application the petitioner was transferred to Satkania Government College, Chittagong vide memo 7H/03Cp-1 /2007/ 9381 /Cp-1 dated 7-3-2007 issued by the Director-General Secondary and Higher Education Directorate, Bangladesh, Dhaka (Annexure-E). It is the categorical assertion of the Petitioner that he never applied for transfer from his station of college and that during the relevant time he was suffering from jaundice, for the said reason he had to undergo intense treatment (annexing doctor's certificate, Annexure-G series) resulting in his failure to join the respective College. Ultimately, he tendered his resignation on 18-4-2007 (Annexure-H) addressing the Respondent No. 1. The content of the said letter is quoted below:—

Subsequently, the Petitioner vide letter dated 10-9-2007 (Annexure-I) narrating the cause for not being able to join the respective College made a prayer to Respondent No. 1 to treat the period of absence as " extraordinary leave" without pay and with a further prayer to place him in any College near Dhaka. On 13-9-2007 (Annexure-K) the Petitioner made an application to the Principle of Satkania Government College with a prayer to allow him to join the respective college. At this point, the categorical assertion of the Petitioner is that through under the pressing situation he tendered his resignation on 18-4-2007 (Annexure-I-I), but later he made representation to allow him to join in the respective post upon treating his leave of absence as extra-ordinary leave, which is tantamount to withdrawal of his resignation letter be necessary implication.
